subject: Playbook: stage storyboard, rapid demo scripts, and B-roll instructions
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Amy Park <amy@brightwave.co>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HealthAI Summit — sponsor requests & assets

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for sponsoring HealthAI Summit. Our event producer asked me to confirm a short list of materials we need from Redwood for the sponsor loop and the booth:

- One-pager (PDF) for the sponsor table
- A 30–45s b-roll clip we can use in the sponsor reel (video or high-quality MP4)
- A stage storyboard + 2 quick demo scripts (90s each) you plan to run on the sponsor stage
- Any logo/brand guidelines (SVG/PNG)

Can you confirm whether you can deliver drafts by EOD Thursday (9/16)? We also have a 20-minute producer check on Fri 9/17 if you want to run through the storyboard live.

I've attached the Acme/producer stage requirements (Acme_stage_req.pdf) — there are AV constraints noted on page 2.

Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the clear list and the PDF.

We can hit a draft handoff by EOD Thursday. Proposed deliverables and owners below:

- Exhibit one-pager (internal draft): laura_bennett — PDF attached (redwood_exhibit_onepager_draft_v1.pdf)
- Stage storyboard (sketch + callouts): marissa_cole — booth_storyboard_sketch_v2.pdf (will refine)
- Two 90s demo scripts (rapid scripts): sean_gallagher + karthik_iyer — see notes below
- B-roll shotlist & rough footage: laura_bennett — b-roll_shotlist_v1.docx (we'll export MP4 if needed)

Quick asks from our side:
- AV confirmation from the producer about 16:9 vs 4:3 (Jordan: can you confirm?)
- Is the sponsor reel accepting MP4s under 50 MB or do we need to supply a YouTube link?

I put a very rough one-pager in the attachments. It's a content-first, scannable layout; please skim and flag anything that absolutely can't be published.

Thanks — I'll circulate updated storyboards after the afternoon walkthrough with Marissa.

—Laura

Nice — adding a few practical notes from the demo side:

- Two demos we should storyboard:
  1) "Predictable inference" — 90s walkthrough: show request -> routed model variant -> latency metric overlay -> cost per token callout
  2) "Graceful degradation" — 90s: simulate model fallback to quantized variant + same prompt, show continuity of UX

- For the stage, we should write a 30s intro, two 90s demos, and a 30s close — keep transitions tight.
- B-roll wishlist: server-rack (45s), UI walkthrough (60s with cursor moves), engineering clip (15s) — director prefers short, labeled clips.

Timing: can produce demo scripts + annotated timestamps by EOD 9/15 if Marissa can deliver storyboards by tomorrow morning.

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Team — quick update after our internal sketch session.

- Marissa attached updated storyboard sketches (booth_storyboard_sketch_v2.pdf). Focus: two-stage flow (sponsor reel -> stage demo -> audience Q&A). Marissa, please add panel labels and sequence numbers to each frame.
- Sean / Karthik: I've penciled you in to draft the rapid scripts — please follow this micro-format: 1) Presenter line (30s intro), 2) Demo steps with timecodes, 3) closing CTA (10s).
- B-roll: I'll export the UI walkthrough as MP4 and share the link by EOD today. Amy, Brightwave requested a single MP4 under 50 MB; we'll provide both MP4 and a high-res Drive link.

Producer question (Jordan): AV is 16:9 and sponsor reel accepts MP4 under 60 MB. Please confirm whether Brightwave needs us to upload directly to a shared folder or send via WeTransfer.

Attaching: redwood_exhibit_onepager_draft_v1.pdf; booth_storyboard_sketch_v2.pdf; b-roll_shotlist_v1.docx
